newsitem.title: USA: Internal Revenue takes steps against trusts - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Internal Revenue takes steps against trusts - WSJ.

text.p: The Internal Revenue Service has started to take action against trusts it believes were set up in order to avoid taxes, the Wall Street Journal said in Friday's electronic edition.

The newspaper said IRS officials have identified about 200,000 trusts deemed "abusive." About $1 billion in assets and personal trust will likely be affected by the agency's new strategy, according to Thomas Wilson Jr, the IRS's national director for corporate examinations, the paper said.

The U.S. tax collection agency said its actions would not affect legitimate trusts, but people holding "abusive trusts" were subject to back taxes, fines and possible criminal prosecution, the Journal said.
